name: parasite
description: Parasite — a real-time multiplayer social deduction game with Inco-encrypted hidden roles

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,web -c magenta,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @parasite/server && npm run build -w @parasite/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @parasite/shared && npm run test -w @parasite/server && npm run test -w @parasite/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @parasite/shared && npm run typecheck -w @parasite/server && npm run typecheck -w @parasite/web
